AEquivalentLazyControl.scope: Same full flow and rule; skip only quotes whose predictive features cannot qualify. This is an unintegrated ordering optimization, not current trader behavior.

workloadScenarios.limitations: One candidate after full warmup; support3/min assumes one admission/rotation per minute. Current trader quote-first ordering fetches6/min even on quiet warm flow. Lazy control avoids those when predictive failure is already known. Same trade may contain multiple swaps; count unique selected transaction requests. No held transaction enrichment is added. Common held pricing must be allocated once separately; these totals do not prove service deadlines.

equivalentRetrievalControl.baselineSource: src/trader.ts warm-window quote:null -> fresh-size-specific-quote-unavailable -> quote before predictive thresholds
equivalentRetrievalControl.controlSource: flowCanNeedQuote prechecks the same frozen predictive requirements without changing them; full evaluatePrimary still decides using a fresh real input quote when needed.
equivalentRetrievalControl.requestFloorPolicy: Every modeled future quote uses max(last actually verified quote slot, latest verified selected-flow slot) and all original quote/source/pool checks; skipped quotes never invent a newer state slot.
operationalGaps: Production RpcMarket currently tracks migration and actually obtained quote slots, but no new verified-flow-slot handoff was integrated here.

Omitted nonqualifying quotes also omit their price/support observations and may change later knowledge/failure timing; identical provided-oracle synthetic signals do not prove identical live operational behavior.
Recorded refusal kind/evidence may differ because an unfetched quote remains unavailable; no qualified entry may bypass the full rule or ledger.
Held-position monitoring is independent and must not rely on candidate quotes that this control skips.
equivalentRetrievalControl.recommendation: Review equivalent retrieval deferral before adding any new screen. No production behavior changed and no economic result is inferred.

dataRetentionControl.A: Fetch full transaction and retain required fields
dataRetentionControl.AretainFewerFields: The exact same physical getTransaction requests still occur; selective retention changes storage only.
dataRetentionControl.C: A separate versioned hypothesis can omit broad flow subscription, but loses buyer/netbuy/persistence information; it is not an equivalent implementation of A.

retainedProjection.interpretation: Serialized transaction result objects versus mapped evidence only; not original HTTP envelope, whitespace, framing or the190,905byte entire selection pass. Both variants fetch and parse the same full transactions. Keep selected raw proof separately for reproduction. Canonical swap identity/transfer mapping is verified; current full mint/vault/fee support was not admitted in that preflight.

retained.reason: Retained16batch sample has15usable identical size-specific quotes and no matched selected flow. It contains no chronological complete entry dataset, funded/disposable account lifecycle or natural entry/exit outcomes. Sparse quiet quotes cannot establish relative strategy returns.

recommendation.A: Retain as frozen comparison baseline; edge remains unproven.
recommendation.B: Do not integrate an extra screen. Existing support/liquidity/quote checks are already mandatory and should be reused. The new10s price-sign gate changes selection, consumes incremental quotes when not otherwise available and delays warming; economic value remains unassessed.
recommendation.C: Economically not assessable; no fabricated flow fields or implicit production strategy replacement.

limitations: All changing prices, flows, exact amounts, trader identities and validations in synthetic scenarios are generated fixtures, not natural market observations.

Pricing inputs are synthetic already-validated size quotes; this module does not claim live SDK/pool evidence for them. Existing decoder/fees/execution/risk requirements must still pass before any real PAPER fill.
A/B strategy features always come from complete available fixture events after actual observation starts; B never backfills earlier discarded events.
C deliberately changes the information hypothesis and exposes null buyer/netflow fields; results are not same-strategy equivalence.
RPC operation counters are modeled retrieval workloads; no current429 was cleared and no approved request/capture allowance was consumed.
Observation continues after a signal for the matched180s window; counts are not per-filled-trade lifecycle cost.
No P&L, return, drawdown, winner statistics or profitable-entry recommendation is inferred from synthetic signal mechanics.
